app.changelog:
Hotfix over 6.0.

Fixed
- Data loss when upgrading from installs older than 4.5R: the check before deleting the old chroot could miss a still-attached bind and delete through it into internal storage. Detection now covers every layout, and no recursive delete runs while anything is mounted.
- The install no longer continues after a failed cleanup.
- Devices without root reported "no usable tar" instead of naming the real cause. The pre-check now offers the rootless engine rather than starting an install that cannot finish.
- Captured handshakes were not moved into the captured folder.
- Wordlists were not listed in the pickers.
- The terminal could crash on launch with "Cannot create component config directory".

news.title: Stryker 6.0 — Rootless engine & Debian
news.description: The full toolset now runs without root: Stryker boots an arm64 QEMU virtual machine and routes tools into the guest. The chroot moved from Alpine to Debian trixie, the same rootfs the VM boots. Also new: a root-free network scanner (mDNS, SSDP, NetBIOS, SNMP), Cameradar RTSP discovery, a reworked dashboard and VM settings. RouterScan has been removed. arm64-v8a only.
